text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What?! A birthday card?! For me? From
you?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. I remembered when I saw Rudolf
wishing
you a happy birthday earlier, so
it's a bit last
minute.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, only you would admit that to the
birthday
girl's face.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not just a card. It comes with a
present
too. See what it says.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"School turf, 2,400 meter, see you at
the starting
gate." Wait, you're telling
me I get to race you?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, if we go now, you also get a
bonus
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For real?! I get to race you AND
Rudolf?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What will I ever do with you two... How
could I
say no after seeing such jubilant
anticipation on
your faces?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aw, yeah! This is the best birthday
present ever!
Thanks, C.B.! Thanks,
Rudolf!
